title: Let's Learn English Level 2 Lesson 21
subtitle: Trash to Treasure, Part 1
attribution: Source: VOA Learning English – Let's Learn English Level 2, Lesson 21: Trash to Treasure, Part 1 (learningenglish.voanews.com). Public domain. This unofficial study helper is not affiliated with VOA.

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: (on phone, to Pete) Got it. Pete, I promise. I won’t tell anyone. (to herself) Bye. He is so strange.
dialogue.zh: （打电话给皮特）知道了。皮特，我保证。我谁也不会说。（对自己）再见。他真奇怪。

dialogue.speaker: Ashley
dialogue.en: Hey, Anna!
dialogue.zh: 嘿，安娜！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Hi, Ashley!
dialogue.zh: 嗨，阿什莉！

dialogue.speaker: Ashley
dialogue.en: Are you talking to yourself again?
dialogue.zh: 你又在自言自语了？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: No, not this time. I was talking to Pete.
dialogue.zh: 这次没有。我在跟皮特说话。

dialogue.speaker: Ashley
dialogue.en: How’s he doing?
dialogue.zh: 他怎么样？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Good. He has a birthday coming up! But he told me not to tell anyone.
dialogue.zh: 挺好。他生日快到了！可他叫我别告诉任何人。

dialogue.speaker: Ashley
dialogue.en: Why?
dialogue.zh: 为什么？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Well, from the way he was speaking, I don’t think he likes cake or presents or fun.
dialogue.zh: 听他说话的样子，我觉得他不喜欢蛋糕、礼物，也不喜欢热闹。

dialogue.speaker: Ashley
dialogue.en: That sounds like Pete.
dialogue.zh: 听起来就是皮特。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Well, I don’t care. I’m getting him a present. Do you know where I can buy something unique?
dialogue.zh: 反正我不在乎。我要给他买礼物。你知道哪儿能买到特别的东西吗？

dialogue.speaker: Ashley
dialogue.en: I do -- Tanglewood Works. You will definitely find something unique there.
dialogue.zh: 知道——Tanglewood Works。那儿肯定能找到特别的东西。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Great. I’ll go this weekend. Now, speaking of Pete’s birthday, what else should I do? I know. I’ll rent him a clown!
dialogue.zh: 太好了。我这周末去。说到皮特的生日，我还该做什么？我知道了。我给他租个小丑！

dialogue.speaker: Ashley
dialogue.en: Yeah, he’ll never speak to you again.
dialogue.zh: 是啊，那他再也不会跟你说话了。

dialogue.speaker: Professor Bot
dialogue.en: Did you hear Ashley and Anna using the words talk and speak? Talk and speak both mean “to say words.” And, many times, you can use either word without losing any meaning. But there are some differences in when we use these words. The word talk is usually used for conversations between two or more people and informal situations, such as between friends or family. For example, Ashley asks Anna: “Are you talking to yourself again?” Speak is usually used for one-way communication, such as presentations; formal situations, such as a boss speaking with her workers; to talk about language ability; and in polite requests. Keep watching, and listen for the words talk and speak.
dialogue.zh: 你听到阿什莉和安娜用 talk 和 speak 了吗？这两个词都表示“说话”。很多时候用哪个都行，意思差不多。但使用场合有些差别。talk 通常用于两人或多人之间的对话，以及朋友或家人之间这类非正式场合。比如阿什莉问安娜：“Are you talking to yourself again?” speak 通常用于单向交流，比如演讲；正式场合，比如老板对员工讲话；谈论语言能力；以及礼貌请求。继续看，注意听 talk 和 speak。

dialogue.speaker: Sue
dialogue.en: Hey there. Welcome to Tanglewood Works! I’m Sue. How can I help you today?
dialogue.zh: 嗨。欢迎来到 Tanglewood Works！我是苏。今天能帮你什么？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Hi Sue, I’m Anna. A friend told me about your store. She said, “Anna, this place is really unique!”
dialogue.zh: 嗨苏，我是安娜。一个朋友跟我说起你们店。她说：“安娜，这地方真的很特别！”

dialogue.speaker: Sue
dialogue.en: We are! Here at Tanglewood Works, we focus on things that are handmade, reclaimed and recycled.
dialogue.zh: 没错！在 Tanglewood Works，我们做的是手工、再利用和回收的东西。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Wow! That is really good for the environment.
dialogue.zh: 哇！这对环境真的很好。

dialogue.speaker: Sue
dialogue.en: It’s good for you too. Local artists made all of these one-of-a-kind pieces. And I paint most of the furniture.
dialogue.zh: 对你也好。这些独一无二的作品都是本地艺术家做的。家具大多是我刷的漆。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Can I look around?
dialogue.zh: 我可以转转吗？

dialogue.speaker: Sue
dialogue.en: Oh, please do.
dialogue.zh: 当然可以。

dialogue.speaker: Sue
dialogue.en: So, Anna, do you like to make things?
dialogue.zh: 安娜，你喜欢动手做东西吗？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Me? Oh, no. Every time I try to make something, something goes wrong.
dialogue.zh: 我？哦，不。我每次一动手，就会出问题。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Oh, sorry. Sorry.
dialogue.zh: 哦，对不起。对不起。

dialogue.speaker: Sue
dialogue.en: It’s okay. Anna, everybody can make something.
dialogue.zh: 没关系。安娜，每个人都能做出点什么。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Sue, this piece is very interesting!
dialogue.zh: 苏，这件作品很有意思！

dialogue.speaker: Sue
dialogue.en: You know, when I found these pieces, they were broken and in a dumpster. But they spoke to me. And they said, “Save me, Sue! Save me!”
dialogue.zh: 你知道吗，我找到这些东西时，它们是破的，在垃圾箱里。可它们对我说话了。它们说：“救救我，苏！救救我！”

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Sue, what do you mean they “spoke” to you?
dialogue.zh: 苏，你说它们对你“说话”是什么意思？

dialogue.speaker: Sue
dialogue.en: When I see something special that someone has thrown away, I can almost hear it talk.
dialogue.zh: 当我看到别人扔掉的特别的东西，我几乎能听见它说话。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: It’s not saying anything!
dialogue.zh: 它什么也没说啊！

dialogue.speaker: Sue
dialogue.en: Anna, it’s not easy to see the treasure in trash.
dialogue.zh: 安娜，要从垃圾里看出宝贝可不容易。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Or hear it talk.
dialogue.zh: 或者听见它说话。

dialogue.speaker: Sue
dialogue.en: But you can learn. In fact, I teach private classes. And one is called Turning Trash to Treasure.
dialogue.zh: 可你可以学。其实我教私人课。有一门就叫“变废为宝”。

dialogue.speaker: Sue
dialogue.en: Next week, bring in some trash and we’ll turn it into treasure. Just remember – pick some trash that “speaks” to you.
dialogue.zh: 下周带点垃圾来，我们把它变成宝贝。记住——挑那种会对你“说话”的垃圾。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Got it! I’ll see you next week!
dialogue.zh: 明白了！下周见！

dialogue.speaker: Professor Bot
dialogue.en: Will Anna find trash that “speaks” to her? What will it say? We’ll find out next week!
dialogue.zh: 安娜能找到对她“说话”的垃圾吗？它会说什么？我们下周再看！

quiz.prompt: Why does Anna want to buy Pete a present?
choices: He has a birthday coming up
He asked her for a clown

quiz.prompt: What kind of things does Tanglewood Works sell?
What does Sue tell Anna to bring next week?
choices: A painted chair from the dumpster
